newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Feb 17.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Feb 17.

text.p: NIHON KEIZAI SHIMBUN and Agency of Natural Resources and Energy may abolish restrictions on oil product exports as early as this year.

Japan"s corporate capital investment in telecommunications is expected to post slower growth in 1997/98, a survey by the Nihon Keizai Shimbun showed. Investment in the sector is estimated to grow two percent year-on-year to around 4.35 trillion yen in the year from April 1997, compared with robust rises of around 20 percent in the previous two years.

Some Japanese companies are likely to include stock appraisal losses in their earnings for the year to March 31 due to price falls on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. Haseko Corp"s stock appraisal loss is expected to be about 10 billion yen and Kobe Steel Ltd"s about nine billion yen. Some companies may lower their earnings forecasts for 1996/97 as a result of the appraisal losses.
